title: Accomplishments, with the record behind them.
intro: The work and recognition of Jason Colapietro and Suede: businesses built, software shipped, books published, and contributions accepted. Each entry links to the underlying record.

records.title: #1 in Palm Beach County, top 25 in Florida for AI deployment
records.body: On October 31, 2026, Suede SEO ranked #1 among Palm Beach County-based companies and Top 25 in Florida in The Manifest’s AI Deployment directory. Suede was founded by Jason Colapietro in West Palm Beach.

records.body: Paul Rowe, founder of NeuralAdX Ltd, cites Suede SEO’s comparison of AI visibility tools and managed GEO implementation in The Three Pillars of AI Visibility, updated October 28, 2026. The article explores how measurement, technical implementation and ongoing optimization work together.

records.body: Suede holds both top-pick positions in AI Agents Directory's music category. The live category lists 52+ music tools.

records.title: Built, scaled, and exited businesses
records.body: Before founding Suede, Jason Colapietro built and ran call centers in his niche and exited for millions. The sales scripts he wrote remain in use across the industry. That operating experience now informs Suede’s managed agents for call review, lead qualification, and sales-script consistency.

records.title: Founder and CEO of Suede; Manager of JC Investment Group LLC
records.body: Jason is founder and CEO of Suede, working on AI integration, search visibility, AI agents and creator-ownership infrastructure: proof of creation, rights metadata, licensing, royalty routing, and agent commerce. He is also manager of JC Investment Group LLC, a founder-led venture platform organized in Florida in 2019 under document L19000146068, alongside the Suede Foundation at suedeai.org. JC Investment Group LLC is the holding company for Suede.

records.title: Google Cloud and the Vertex AI suite
records.body: Suede has worked in partnership with Google Cloud since September 2025, with a dedicated account team, a Google Premier Partner assigned to support the account, and migration of the stack onto the Vertex AI suite, including Gemini, Vertex AI Agent Builder, and Veo. The account team’s published quote calls Suede an ideal partner for promoting the Vertex suite.

records.title: Google Cloud Partner Advantage
records.body: JC Investment Group LLC became a member of Google Cloud Partner Advantage on September 4, 2026, with suedeai.ai as the verified domain. The membership is a second milestone in the Google Cloud partnership that began in September 2025.

records.title: 63 merged pull requests. 54 external repositories.
records.body: The public record includes 41 substantive code or documentation contributions and 22 accepted listings of Jason-owned work. Maintainers have merged contributions into projects including Jest, Adobe React Spectrum, Backstage, Hardhat, and the x402 Foundation. Jason also has 1 public Linux kernel contribution, to USB/IP (Public upstream v7), counted on top of the 63 merged pull requests. Adobe React Spectrum merged #10426, which #10491 later superseded.

links.label: Every merged PR outside Jason’s own repositories, on GitHub

records.title: A feature in Adobe’s design system, and fixes in Backstage, Hardhat, zeroclaw, and the Polkadot SDK
records.body: The contributions to lead with: a public useShowFocusIndicator hook accepted into Adobe React Spectrum by a core maintainer; a catalog-graph fix in Backstage, the CNCF developer-portal framework; removal of the retired Holesky chain descriptor from Hardhat, merged by a project lead; a daemon socket-ownership fix in the zeroclaw runtime, 767 lines of Rust across two crates; an RPC capacity-release fix in the Polkadot SDK; and two Jest fixes, one isolating virtual mock module IDs and one tolerating a transient watcher error.

records.title: Listed in fifteen independent skills directories and the x402 ecosystem list
records.body: Suede Creator Skills, the public Claude Code skills marketplace, has been accepted by the maintainers of fifteen independent awesome-lists and directories, including buildwithclaude, awesome-codex, awesome-agent-skills, and awesome-claude-code-plugins. Suede Agent Studio is listed in the x402 ecosystem’s awesome-x402. These accepted listings are among the 63 merged pull requests above.

records.title: Five published books, plus independent works
records.body: The Amazon catalog holds The Human Authenticity Layer, Proof as Infrastructure, Stake Your Claim, The Claude Code Bible, and Codex in Production; the two operator guides were republished on KDP as Edition 2 on September 4, 2026. Independent works include The Screenshot, free to read on the web with its source edition on GitHub; The Signal Chain; and The Guitar Without a Number, now incorporated into The Signal Chain.

records.title: More than 30 sites, and a published app family
records.body: Jason builds and operates the Suede estate across creative software, music practice, AI agent tools, and developer infrastructure: Suede Social, Strumly, Suede Muse, Suede Agent Studio, the Suede IP Registry, Suede Studio, Suede Distro, Suede Scan, Agentix, and Suede DNA, among more than 30 live sites. Nine apps are published under Jason Colapietro’s Apple developer account. Eighteen owned brand domains carry a single canonical entity, entered at jasoncolapietro.com.

records.title: 100+ apps built; 17 live store listings (9 App Store, 6 Google Play, 2 Chrome extensions)
records.body: Jason Colapietro has built more than 100 apps. 17 are live in public stores: 9 on the Apple App Store, 6 on Google Play and 2 Chrome Web Store extensions. The App Store line under his developer account includes Suede Voice, Suede AI Generator, Suede Agent Studio, StoryBeam Kids, Suede Guitar Tuner & Studio, GuitarHub, Suede Social, Agentix and Suede Studio Muse. The Chrome extensions are Suede AI Visibility and Suede Sing for Chrome.

records.title: Agent flows that ship as x402 endpoints settling in USDC on Base
records.body: Suede Agent Studio lets a builder draw an agent as a node graph and launch it as an x402 pay-per-call endpoint settling in USDC on Base, with Agentix tracking per-call earnings. The work implements the x402 protocol and ERC-8004 and includes a merged fix in the x402 Foundation’s own repository.

records.title: Five provisional patent applications
records.body: Five USPTO provisional patent applications are on file: 63/946,189, 63/946,192, 63/946,212, 63/946,217 and 63/947,120, with filing receipts issued in January 2026.

records.title: Admitted to Stripe Startups
records.body: Suede was admitted to Stripe Startups in July 2026, alongside the ongoing Google Cloud relationship and the company’s work on creative software and agent commerce.

records.title: 21 course credentials and 17 Microsoft Learn training achievements
records.body: Jason Colapietro holds nine Claude Academy / Anthropic completion badges, including Claude Platform 101, Claude with Amazon Bedrock and Claude on Google Cloud; five Semrush Academy certificates; HubSpot Academy AEO Fundamentals certification; two Google Skills completion badges; Databricks Academy Generative AI Fundamentals accreditation; IBM SkillsBuild’s Craft Precise Prompts for AI Models digital credential; and Hugging Face’s Fundamentals of Agents certificate (90%). His Microsoft Learn record includes 15 module badges and two learning-path trophies: Develop AI agents on Azure and Develop generative AI apps in Azure. AWS Skill Builder records his Amazon Bedrock Getting Started course completion certificate, issued October 21, 2026. Google GEAR program membership is recorded separately.

records.title: Florida Atlantic and 1909
records.body: Jason is enrolled at the Florida Atlantic Entrepreneurship Institute in FAU’s College of Business and is a member of 1909, the entrepreneurship hub in downtown West Palm Beach. FAU’s entrepreneurship research was ranked No. 8 worldwide in its published 2025 announcement; that ranking belongs to the university’s research program.

records.title: Thirteen feature placements across seven outlets
records.body: Gigawatt Group, MSN, Business Insider, TechBullion, Programming Insider, Altcoin Investor, and Indie Hackers have published coverage and founder essays about Suede. The record includes Gigawatt Group’s September 2026 comparison of Suede’s managed GEO practice with Profound, the SEO and AI cohort carried by MSN and Business Insider, the on-chain IP authentication launch, the iOS and developer-tool launches, advancing in the Avalanche Build Games, creator ownership infrastructure, the IP visibility audit, and self-funded education deployments in African classrooms. Two placements are Jason’s bylined essays.

records.title: Mario Nawfal posts and Crypto Roundtable AMA
records.body: Mario Nawfal featured Suede in two public posts eight months apart. The Suede AMA also ran on his Crypto Roundtable. The posts discuss creator control, ownership, and a voice signature that can travel with the work.

records.title: Suede in a screenshot on Elon Musk’s timeline
records.body: Elon Musk posted a screenshot of proposed Community Notes about AI training data. One of the proposed notes visible in that screenshot names Suede as an opt-out option. The archived capture of the post recorded 2.7 million views.

records.title: Google's Web Guide calls Suede highly rated
records.body: Asked to review Suede, Google's Web Guide, the AI-organized results layer inside Google Search, opens by calling the company highly rated by users, earning a 5/5 rating from verified reviews for its creator-ownership infrastructure, and cites the two App Store listings it drew that from. The quote comes from a dated capture of that Google Search response on September 6, 2026.

links.label: Suede AI Generator on the App Store

records.title: Gemini names Suede alongside Suno and Udio
records.body: In the February capture, Gemini places Suede in a “New Big 3” of AI music platforms beside Suno and Udio, describing it as “The Creator’s IP Fortress.” A separate March session discusses Jason’s experience and Suede’s architecture. Both are dated Gemini responses, captured on the dates above and linked below.

records.title: First in a nine-platform AI music comparison
records.body: The comparison archived on Suede SEO ranks Suede first in its Best AI Music Generators of 2026 table, scoring it 5.0 out of 5.0 across music quality, creative control, ease of use, and overall value. The receipt preserves the table and the announcement card with their capture date.

records.title: Best Overall and Best API Option
records.body: The AI Agents Directory music-category capture names Suede Best Overall and Best API Option among 47 tools, with a 5.0-star listing. The archived record and the live category page are linked separately so readers can distinguish the recorded recognition from today’s directory.

records.title: Wikidata and Crunchbase entries, plus an Apple-hosted developer page
records.body: Third-party records describe Jason independently of anything Suede publishes: a Wikidata item, a Crunchbase founder profile, and Apple’s developer page listing nine shipped apps under his name. One person carries two public names, Jason Colapietro and Johnny Suede, and every surface states the linkage rather than letting them drift into separate records.

records.title: The method, the research, and the tools are public
records.body: Suede publishes the full method behind its GEO practice in The Screenshot and the Founder’s Checklist. The company blog includes original research such as the AI Crawler Access Index, alongside engineering essays and creator-rights guides. Jason also publishes independently on Substack, and releases reusable developer skills through Suede’s public repositories.
